title: Edible Cobblestone
description: This mod allows you to eat cobblestone and other rocks in minecraft
body:
![a player eating a block of cobblestone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/WVGACWBD/images/e9ec2bec18a14cdd78f73d5388acfed00491f2f7.gif)
a joke that went too far, and got created into a mod.

This mod allows you to not just eat cobblestone, but also most other vanilla rocks as well!
![eating a block of netherrack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/WVGACWBD/images/2f27c069779f1dfc6e82122ce1ea5de9939bd3d8.gif)
As of version 1.0.1, you can eat the following rocks: Stone, Cobblestone, Deepslate, Cobbled Deepslate, Diorite, Andesite, Granite and Netherrack

There are also some additional items you can make that cause different things when eaten. An example is a bowl of Sodium Sulfate, crafted using sodium and gunpowder. When eaten, it causes some, "explosive", effects
![eating bowl of sodium sulfate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/WVGACWBD/images/c3e3fa4f0f15a6c09140456db57f35d8c6238ab8.gif)
There are three levels of this item (regular, strong and extra strong) that cause stronger explosions, along with launching you higher, as the tier goes up.

Other items of this nature include the bowl of lava, which when eaten, ignites the player instantly.

Also added in are 2 types of stone-based cereal, being CobblOs and ObsidOs. The former being made with cobblestone, the latter being made with obsidian. You can combine these cereals in a bowl with either Milk, Lava, or the new Nuclear Waste item to produce bowls of cereal that give different amounts of hunger and potion effects. If you want the safest option, going with Milk is the best bet.
